sandbachFocus: Sandbach United maintained their excellent form with a hard-fought 1-0 home victory over fourth-placed Eccleshall on Saturday. Josh Fowles opened the scoring early in the first half, and despite Eccleshall pressing hard in the second half—particularly after Sandbach's Hatton was sin-binned—the Ramblers held firm to secure the three points. The win extends Sandbach's unbeaten run, though they remain level on 19 points with AFC Bridgnorth and Stafford Town at the top of the table.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth continue their impressive run at the summit, having played only seven matches so far. Stafford Town drew 2-2 with Cheadle Heath Nomads after going ahead at the break, with Tom Efford receiving a second yellow card late in the match to leave them down to ten men. Bilston Town dominated Market Drayton Town, winning 3-0 away with goals from Dixon, Crump, and Bustin, while Market Drayton had a player sent off. Allscott Heath won 3-1 at home against struggling Alsager Town with goals from James Allen, Liam Parkinson, and Kian Newnes. New Mills lost 2-1 away at Dawley Town despite equalizing through Will Frankish. Wolverhampton Casuals came from behind to beat Shawbury United 3-1 away, with Shawbury equalizing early in the second half before Casuals scored twice more including a penalty from Kieran Cook. Telford Town fell to a 1-0 home defeat against Barnton. Brereton Social led 1-0 at half-time against AFC Bridgnorth courtesy of an own goal. Crewe hosted Wednesfield Community in a match with limited coverage. Foley Meir's fixture against Widnes Town had no final result posted in the available data.
